text:
Maria (partnerships): FYI — ACME SI (Nexus) flagged an architecture sign-off needed for their private deployment. They want on‑prem GPUs + KMS + VPC peering + our private control plane. Customer timeline: P0 next-week pilot. Can we get an architecture review + any known blockers? @Ajay @Sam

Ajay (solutions): Thanks — do we have an existing runbook for on‑prem GPU + KMS? Also need SI SOW details. @Lucy can you share ACME contact/timeline?

Sam (eng-ml): Do we have model quantization / kernel support confirmed for their A100 cluster? If they're on CUDA 12 they might need a fallback kernel. I can run a quick compatibility check if we get AMI details or driver info.

Lucy (customer-success): I have ACME PO & infra sheet. Pilot start 3/29, need review by EOD Fri. I'll DM creds to Ajay. ACME insists on HSM for key storage.

Maria (partnerships): Also the SI wants a formal joint announcement post-pilot. Need to capture any compliance gaps early. @deploy-bot create channel #acme-si-integration?

deploy-bot: Channel #acme-si-integration created by Maria.

Ajay (solutions): Meeting propose: Thu 10am PT — attendees: Ajay, Sam, Eng infra rep (TBD), ACME infra lead, SI PM. Agenda: network topology, KMS/HSM flow, model runtime compatibility, SOW items. Is Thu ok?

Sam (eng-ml): Thu 10 works. I'll bring kernel/quant notes. Quick ask: do we have allowed IP ranges for their private control plane? Need firewall rules before demo.

Lucy (customer-success): ACME can early whitebox test but won't share private IPs until MSA signed. They can share subnet ranges. I'll try to get provisional ranges by tomorrow.

Maria (partnerships): Escalation: SI reported repeated OOM during load test with batch size 16 on 8xV100. We should capture a small repro. Ajay / Sam can someone take lead?

Ajay (solutions): I'll take repro. Can SI send model config + logs. Suggest we ask for perf profile and a small docker image with model weights (or a script to pull).

Sam (eng-ml): If they're on V100 we might need a different kernel or quant profile. Send them this snippet for env checks:
```
NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION=470
CUDA_VERSION=11.4
LD_PRELOAD=/opt/redwood/optimized_kernels.so
```
Also ask for pmap of memory and `nvidia-smi -q` output.

Lucy (customer-success): I'll collect logs and push to S3 link once ACME approves. Expect link by EOD today.

Maria (partnerships): Great. Can someone own escalation if we hit puppet-level infra blockers? Need owner for L2 support during pilot.

Ajay (solutions): I'll be L2 lead during pilot week. Sam will be L3 kernel/quant. I'll update the runbook and ping eng-infra.

Sam (eng-ml): I'll also prepare a short checklist for on‑prem acceptance: kernel compat, driver version, disk throughput, KMS integration tests, and a minimal perf repro.

Lucy (customer-success): Noted. I'll confirm pilot dates with ACME and share calendar invites once meeting time confirmed.

Maria (partnerships): +1 thanks team. We'll aim for rapid turnaround; this is a strategic SI case. :rocket:
